_why: Lower bounds, not equalities: adding tests is free, losing them is red. A tier that silently stops running tests is the defect this exists for -- 62 browser tests vanish on a host without Chrome, and U3V's ctest registers 37 of 51 while printing '100% tests passed'.
_how: make fast / make check pass --tier-manifest=<tier>; raise a number here only in the merge request that adds the tests.
